payload.summary: /favourites and /?mode=favourites render visibly different homes for the same mode
payload.detail: The standalone hero lockup was deliberately deleted from favourites-command-library-page.tsx (ledger #164), but the dashboard variant FavouritesHub (src/components/clinical-dashboard/favourites-hub.tsx:179) still renders ModeHomeHero with 'Favourites / Saved notes, sources, and sets.' So the same mode looks different depending on the door. Decide which treatment is canonical and apply it to both. Found during the PR #2160 cross-mode audit.
